english.title: Fail to surrender intoxicating liquor to an accredited person - Police Reform

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: CONFISCATION OF ALCOHOL YOUNG PERSONS ACT 1997

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed without reasonable excuse to comply with a requirement imposed on you by a person accredited under the Police Reform Act 2002 to

(A)_[surrender what was, or was reasonably suspected by the accredited person to be, intoxicating liquor or a container for such liquor in your possession]_
(B)_[state your name and address]_
(C)_[surrender what was, or was reasonably suspected by the accredited person to be, intoxicating liquor or a container for such liquor in your possession and to state your name and address]_
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 5 of Schedule 5 to the Police Reform Act 2002, and section 1(3) of the Confiscation of Alcohol (Young Persons) Act 1997.

english.notes:
(i) See section13 for the meaning of "designated public place".
(ii) The above offence relates to powers assigned to a person accredited under under Schedule 5 to the Police Reform Act 2002.
(iii) See H16 for the comparable offence in relation to a requirement by a constable.
(iv) See also other offence wordings in relation to the duties of accredited persons:-
H4915 - failed to give name and address to accredited person - relevant offence
H4943 - fail to give name/address to accredited person - act in anti-social manner
H4944 - contravene accredited person's requirement to surrender liquor
H4946 - fail to stop vehicle as directed by an accredited person while escorting load
H4947 - drive vehicle - fail to proceed as directed by an accredited person while escorting load
H4948 - pedestrian fail to proceed as directed by an accredited person while escorting load.
(v) The phrase "other than a sealed container" was removed by Schedule 7 to the Licensing Act 2003.

other.powersofarrest: An accredited person does not have a power of arrest or to detain - however as with any criminal offence a police officer may Arrest without warrant.
other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level two on the legislative standard scale
